label: PolicyPilot showcase agents (operated by the team)
note: These vaults and agent keys are run by the PolicyPilot team to demonstrate the product. They are not external users.

agents.name: DCA bot
agents.about: Buys the largest USDC clip the vault will allow on Uniswap and PancakeSwap every round, then periodically swaps it back to MON and unwraps.

agents.name: Staker
agents.about: Stakes the largest MON clip the vault will allow into Kintsu (sMON), aPriori (aprMON) and Magma (gMON), wraps and unwraps WMON, and swaps that same size on Kuru.

agents.name: Payroll
agents.about: Pays the largest MON salary the vault will allow to an allowlist of team-owned addresses.

agents.name: Rogue agent
agents.about: Deliberately tries out-of-policy actions (over cap, strangers, draining tokens, paying itself, owner-only calls). Every attempt is sent on-chain and reverted by the vault.

agents.name: DCA bot (v1 vault)
agents.about: The original DCA bot on the first (legacy) factory: same strategy, no owner top-ups.

agents.name: Kuru market maker
agents.about: Two-sided flow on Kuru’s on-chain order book: sells the largest MON clip the vault will allow for USDC, then buys MON back with the USDC (approval capped by the vault), round after round.

agents.name: Wrap/unwrap rebalancer
agents.about: Keeps the vault near a 50/50 split of MON and WMON, moving the whole gap in one wrap or unwrap up to the per-action cap. Only WMON.deposit/withdraw are allowlisted.

agents.name: Tipper
agents.about: Pays the full per-action cap to an allowlist of team addresses. The cap is the largest tip the vault will accept.

agents.name: Policy tester
agents.about: Probes the exact edges of its policy: wraps exactly the cap (allowed), then cap + 1 wei (blocked), replays a used requestId (blocked), swaps on Uniswap with the output sent to itself (blocked), pays a stranger (blocked). Blocked attempts are broadcast so the revert is public.
